description: The cook's own published recipes that have no cover photo, a generated placeholder instead of a photo, or a cover that doesn't meet Befana's photo standard (dark, blurry, washed out, too small). Use it to help the cook decide what to reshoot. Returns each recipe's url, the current cover's tier and what's wrong with it.
name: get_photo_queue

asks.description: At most one question for the cook, with a home in preferences

ask_now.description: false when the response also offers a next step: the offer is the turn's one question, so don't ask this now, but save the answer if the cook volunteers it

saves_to.description: Where the answer goes, e.g. update_preferences.servings (after the cook confirms)

say.description: The question, in the cook's terms

next_steps.description: What to offer next, best first. Offer the top one in one sentence; run its tool with its args if the cook says yes

action.description: What the step is, stable across releases: shopping_list, order_groceries, save, fork, draft, share, scale, show_hidden, open_recipe, pantry_update…

args.description: Arguments to pass as they are; the assistant may add what the cook says

say.description: One sentence to offer the cook, in their terms. Ending in "do it without asking" means the cook already asked for it: run it

tool.description: The tool that does it, or null when the assistant does it in conversation (e.g. sharing links)

notices.description: At most one note about Befana to pass on when there's room (one per cook per week; off with workflow whats_new: off)

say.description: One sentence to mention when the conversation has room; never more than one per turn

cover.description: The current cover's URL, or null for none

coverGenerated.description: True when the cover is a generated placeholder illustration, not a photo of the dish

coverTier.description: null when the cover hasn't been scored or there is none

flags.description: What's wrong with the photo: dark, blurry, washed out, too small…

slug.description: The recipe's slug: the id every tool takes

url.description: The recipe page: share it so the cook can follow along (steps check off, timers included)

standard.description: Befana's photo standard, in one sentence

title: Recipes whose photos need work
